meta.description: V20: characteristic-curve IRT scale linking (Haebara / Stocking-Lord, non-symmetric and symmetric) for 2PL, GRM, GPCM, and 3PL.
meta.note: mirt does not implement IRT scale linking; each form is calibrated with mirt and the linking criteria, optima (A, B), and Ogasawara (2001) delta-method SEs are computed in base R directly from Haebara (1980), Stocking & Lord (1983), and Kim & Lee (2006) using mirt's probtrace() and expected.item() for characteristic curves.
